32K likes, 335 comments - elleindia on September 4, 2026: "#ELLEDigitalCoverStar: “Ageing is like the biggest sin that you can commit,” Bipasha Basu (@bipashabasu) laughs. “I believe that I like myself more, the person that I am today, much more than what I used to be in my twenties.” She has no interest in chasing a younger version of herself. “What other people are doing, it’s their call. I don’t judge that. But for me, I’m never going to fall into the pressure of wanting to look younger than what I am. I’m very happy with the way I am growing older, and I’m very proud of my age.” Read more from our conversation at the 🔗 in bio.
______________________________________
On @bipashabasu: Antique gold sequin corset gown and cape, both by @rockystarofficial .
